messages.subject: Verdant v Calderhall Cells – disclosure deadline
messages.plaintextBody:
James — unrelated to Lyra, but the disclosure list in the Verdant v Calderhall Cells battery-defect litigation is due to the other side by 4 December. Tom asked whether you can spare an hour to review the privilege log before it goes out. Let me know.

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
